package.name: mapping_localization_pkg
package.description:
Mapping and localization for the Helios A4WD3 mecanum rover. Everything that owns map -> odom lives here; sensing and odometry fusion stay in perception_pkg. Each approach is a self-contained folder and runs independently of the other:
slam_toolbox/ - 2D LiDAR SLAM (Hokuyo UST-10LX), publishes /map rtabmap/ - 3D RGB-D + LiDAR SLAM (GTSAM pose-graph optimization)
Both are fed by the ZED 2i, the Hokuyo, and the EKF-fused odometry from perception_pkg's sensor_fusion, which must already be running.
